messages:
Noah Martinez: Heads up — engineering plans to change the partner SDK parameter name from `max_batch_size` to `batch_limit` (semantics identical) to align with internal naming. This is breaking for some partner CI and appliance configs. Proposing a 6-week soft deprecation (shim + warnings) then hard cut. Marketplace and HW partners must be notified. Thoughts?

Alicia - Marketplace PM: We have ~18 marketplace integrations using `max_batch_size` in examples and quickstarts. We can add a banner and migration snippet but need 3 weeks lead to publish marketplace docs and auto-update sample code. Recommend announcing now with clear timeline.

Priya Nair: For SIs and hardware appliances, the rename will need config updates. Offer: small shim proxy that maps old param to new one, and a partner migration runbook. Propose 2 canary partners from SI list to test the proxy.

Owen Brooks: From infra, we can accept both params server-side during the migration window and emit `X-Redwood-Deprecation: max_batch_size` header. Also add telemetry to flag usage so partners that haven't moved are visible. Gate: error delta < 0.2% and no latency regressions.

Noah Martinez: Good. Timeline suggestion: Week 0 announce + server accepts both + SDK shim; Week 2 marketplace docs + town hall; Week 4-6 partner migrations + canaries; Week 6 hard cut. Alicia: can you confirm marketplace banner content?

Alicia - Marketplace PM: Yes — will prepare banner and update listing snippets. Town hall Wednesday 10am PT; I'll invite vendors and HW channel leads.

Partner Ops Bot: Reminder: create vendor-impact sheet at /shared/partners/batch-param-rename and schedule town hall after partner list confirmed.

Priya Nair: I'll prepare the proxy repo and runbook. Also offering two migration sessions per partner (1 dev, 1 ops).

Owen Brooks: I'll add telemetry dashboards and a gating job. ETA for server changes: 4 business days.

Noah Martinez: Action items recap: Alicia -> marketplace banner and invites; Priya -> proxy + runbook; Owen -> server dual-accept + telemetry; Noah -> partner announcement draft. Follow-up sync Fri 11am PT. :white_check_mark:
